title: Restriction of an augmented lift and its section-complex comparison
statement: For scheme maps f:X→S and g:S′→S, a module F on X, injective resolutions I of F and J of g′*F, and a complex map t:I→g′_*J lifting the adjunction unit, let V be any open of S and D be any FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices. Put U=f⁻¹V, W=g′⁻¹U and h=g′|W:W→U. There exists a complex map k:D.source.resolution→h_*D.target.resolution preserving the augmentation D.psi. There is a section-complex iso a:Γ(W,D.target.resolution)≅Γ(U,h_*D.target.resolution) whose inverse components are restriction along h⁻¹top=top. The map qV obtained by evaluating flatBaseChangeResolutionQ on V equals D.source.sections.inv followed by Γ(U,k), a.inv and the target section comparison transported along flatBaseChangeOpenEquality. This is a chain-level identity before homology, and has no flatness assumption.

source.place: Tags 01FB, 01EZ and 01E4; fixed-lift computation in the restricted section formula

proof.text: Construct the canonical global-sections/pushforward complex isomorphism degreewise using inverse-image top. Naturality of each differential proves the complex isomorphism; its inverse component formula is definitional. Use the explicit restriction-adjunction lift as k. The augmentation lemma gives the first equality and the section-formula lemma gives the final equality. Package these facts into the required existential and conjunctions.

lean.statement:
theorem flatBaseChangeRestrictedLift_sections {X S S' : Scheme.{uBC}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (g : S' ⟶ S)
    {F : X.Modules}
    (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (J : InjectiveResolution ((tensorPullback (pullback.snd g f)).obj F))
    (t : I.cocomplex ⟶ ((pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).mapHomologicalComplex
      (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
    (ht : I.ι.f 0 ≫ t.f 0 =
      (Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd g f))).unit.app F ≫
        (pushforward (pullback.snd g f)).map (J.ι.f 0))
    (V : S.Opens) (D : FlatBaseChangeOpenChoices f g F I J V) :
    let h := (pullback.snd g f).resLE (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)
      ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)) le_rfl
    let ΓS := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace ⋙
      forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let ΓT := (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor
      ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme.toRingedSpace ⋙
        forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{uBC}).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    ∃ (k : D.source.resolution.cocomplex ⟶
        ((pushforward h).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          D.target.resolution.cocomplex)
      (a : ΓT.obj D.target.resolution.cocomplex ≅
        ΓS.obj (((pushforward h).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj
          D.target.resolution.cocomplex)),
      D.source.resolution.ι.f 0 ≫ k.f 0 =
        D.psi ≫ (pushforward h).map (D.target.resolution.ι.f 0) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, a.inv.f n =
        (Scheme.Modules.presheaf (D.target.resolution.cocomplex.X n)).map
          (eqToHom (by simp) :
            (⊤ : ((pullback.snd g f) ⁻¹ᵁ (f ⁻¹ᵁ V)).toScheme.Opens) ⟶
              h ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (f ⁻¹ᵁ V).toScheme.Opens)).op) ∧
      ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections S.toRingedSpace V).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map (flatBaseChangeResolutionQ f g I J t) =
      D.source.sections.inv ≫ ΓS.map k ≫ a.inv ≫
        (D.target.sections ≪≫ eqToIso (congrArg (fun U ↦
          ((RingedSpace.openModuleSections
            (Limits.pullback g f).toRingedSpace U).mapHomologicalComplex
              (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj J.cocomplex)
              (flatBaseChangeOpenEquality f g V))).hom
